reviews.author: SarahJ_88
reviews.title: Subscription trap
reviews.content: I downloaded this app thinking it was free. After a 3-day trial they charged me $29.99 without any clear notification. The cancel button is buried deep in settings. This feels like a scam. Be careful!

reviews.author: Mike_fitness
reviews.title: Hidden charges
reviews.content: Same issue here. Got charged $29.99 after the trial ended. No reminder email, no push notification. Very deceptive billing practice. I want a refund.

reviews.author: EmilyYoga
reviews.title: Love the workouts
reviews.content: These workouts are amazing! I have been using this app for 3 months now and I can see real results. The instructors are great and the variety keeps me motivated.

reviews.author: JohnDoe_99
reviews.title: Good workouts but overpriced
reviews.content: The workout content is actually pretty good but the subscription price is too high compared to alternatives. $29.99/month is ridiculous when other apps offer similar content for $9.99.

reviews.author: SarahJ_88
reviews.title: Subscription trap
reviews.content: I downloaded this app thinking it was free. After a 3-day trial they charged me $29.99 without any clear notification. The cancel button is buried deep in settings. This feels like a scam. Be careful!

reviews.author: LisaG_77
reviews.title: Best home workout app
reviews.content: I have tried many workout apps and this is by far the best. The progress tracking feature is my favorite - it keeps me accountable. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tom_Runner
reviews.title: Crashes on iPhone 12
reviews.content: The app keeps crashing when I try to open the HIIT workout section. I have an iPhone 12 with latest iOS. Please fix this bug, otherwise the app is unusable for me.

reviews.author: AnnaB_fit
reviews.title: Great but needs Apple Watch support
reviews.content: I love the workouts but I really wish this app had Apple Watch integration. Having to look at my phone during workouts is annoying. Please add Watch support!

reviews.author: DavidKim
reviews.title: Cannot cancel subscription
reviews.content: I have been trying to cancel my subscription for weeks. The cancel button does not work in the app and I had to go through Apple support to finally cancel. Terrible user experience.

reviews.author: Maria_Lopez
reviews.title: Too many ads in free version
reviews.content: I understand it is a freemium app but the amount of ads is ridiculous. You get an ad every 30 seconds during workouts. It completely ruins the flow. At least reduce the frequency.

reviews.author: FitnessFan2024
reviews.title: Transformed my routine
reviews.content: This app completely transformed my fitness routine. The personalized workout plans are spot on and the video quality is excellent. Worth every penny of the subscription.

reviews.author: KevinZ_88
reviews.title: Decent but limited free content
reviews.content: The free version has very limited content. Only 3 workouts available without paying. I wish there was a middle ground between the ad-supported free version and the expensive premium.

reviews.author: JenniferW
reviews.title: Charged during free trial
reviews.content: I was charged $29.99 on day 2 of my 7-day free trial. When I contacted support they said it was a system error but I still have not received my refund 2 weeks later. Unacceptable.

reviews.author: Alex_Moran
reviews.title: Good app, needs improvement
reviews.content: Overall a solid workout app. The exercises are well-designed and the timers are helpful. However, sometimes the audio cuts out randomly during workouts which is frustrating.

reviews.author: RachelT_yoga
reviews.title: Subscription too expensive
reviews.content: $29.99 per month is way too expensive for what you get. I switched to a competitor that charges $9.99 for similar content. You need to reconsider your pricing strategy.

reviews.author: Chris_Hiker
reviews.title: Perfect for home gym
reviews.content: Perfect companion for my home gym setup. The workout variety is incredible and I love how I can customize my routines. The offline mode is a nice touch too.

reviews.author: Nina_P
reviews.title: App freezes during workout
reviews.content: The app freezes occasionally during my workout, usually when transitioning between exercises. I have to force close and restart. Using iPhone 13 Pro with iOS 17.4.

reviews.author: BrianT_lift
reviews.title: Great strength training
reviews.content: The strength training programs are excellent. I have gained noticeable muscle mass in 2 months. Would give 5 stars but the rest timer is sometimes inaccurate.

reviews.author: Olivia_M
reviews.title: Worst subscription experience
reviews.content: This is the worst subscription experience I have ever had. They make it impossible to cancel and the customer support is non-existent. I am reporting this to Apple.

reviews.author: Paul_fit
reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.content: Been using for 6 months. Lost 15 pounds and feel great. The meal plans are a nice bonus too. The community feature keeps me motivated.

reviews.author: Grace_L
reviews.title: No Apple Watch support
reviews.content: It is 2024 and this app still does not support Apple Watch. Every other fitness app has this. I do not want to carry my phone during runs. Please add this feature!

reviews.author: MarkD_strength
reviews.title: Solid app
reviews.content: Really solid app with great workout variety. The progress tracking could be better - I wish I could see my historical data in charts instead of just lists.

reviews.author: Sophie_Yoga
reviews.title: Good but buggy
reviews.content: The yoga sessions are great but the app has bugs. Sometimes my progress does not save and I lose my streak. Fix the bugs and it would be 5 stars.

reviews.author: Dan_CrossFit
reviews.title: Scam billing
reviews.content: Charged me for 3 months before I realized I was still subscribed. No email receipts, no notifications. This is clearly designed to trap users. Avoid!

reviews.author: Amy_Zhang
reviews.title: Life changing
reviews.content: This app changed my life. I went from never exercising to working out 5 times a week. The beginner programs are perfect and gradually increase in difficulty.

reviews.author: RobertK_fit
reviews.title: Audio issues
reviews.content: The background music keeps cutting out during workouts. I have tried reinstalling but the issue persists. Using iPhone 14 Pro. Very annoying.

reviews.author: HelenP_active
reviews.title: Great for beginners
reviews.content: As a beginner I found this app very welcoming. The instructions are clear and the modifications for different fitness levels are helpful. Wish there were more prenatal workouts though.

reviews.author: James_L
reviews.title: Decent but needs work
reviews.content: The workouts are good but the UI feels outdated. The app also takes too long to load on startup. Needs performance optimization.

reviews.author: Catherine_W
reviews.title: Auto-renewal nightmare
reviews.content: I turned off auto-renewal but they still charged me. Customer service took 2 weeks to respond and then refused to refund. This is borderline illegal.

reviews.author: Victor_M
reviews.title: Best fitness investment
reviews.content: Best $30/month I spend. The personalization is incredible - it adapts to my progress and always pushes me just enough. The form check feature using the camera is genius.
